scope: one-cell CS2-35 measurement reconstruction DataV1; no models or other cells
reparse_first10_reason: Old105207 rows counted but not persisted; old304 summaries lack per-discharge rest baseline,step times,raw provenance. Old counter endpoint extraction cannot represent physical per-discharge capacity; one versioned recovery of affected source files required. All old artifacts retained and same old summaries compared.
measurement_rule: Qcounter = last negative-current same-step counter minus immediately preceding rest sample counter within same source cycle; no cross-cycle or future differencing. Qintegral = -I_first*Step_Time_first/3600 + adjacent trapezoids over negative-current samples. Accepted only for one observed CC discharge with complete preceding charge tail, rest baseline, matching step-time boundary, stable current, cutoff sample, no counter resets, finite monotone times and counter/integral agreement. Retain every invalid/uncertain occurrence and flags; no smoothing/monotonicity/deletion.
tolerances_limit: engineering sampled-signal consistency; does not attest exact hardware cutoff, calibration or absolute true capacity
EOL_rule: Only first observed valid Q<=0.88 may be reported as observed crossing. True first-passage/global native-cycle RUL labels remain blocked if inter-file missing-cycle/identity continuity unproven. No end-of-record as event.
boundaries: Preserve sourcefile/cycle/step/testtime/walltime; no renumbering source cycles. Record interfile resets/gaps/overlap, do not merge. Observed occurrence ordering is not native elapsed cycle count.
dedup_rule: Only exact identical full-cycle raw signals excluding source_row map to duplicate aliases; retain each source. Same end walltime and sourcecycle but differing raw signals are semantic conflicts and uncertain, not merged. No capacity trend used.
